requirements.description: User wants the building located near public transport. The request uses proximity language, so the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71).

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The capacity of 60 people is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was supplied. The energy class and public transport requirements have no matching reference column and are not extracted. The location 'Turin' is a city name, so it is handled by the Location Agent and not mapped to comune_code.

User prefers energy class C or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through A4, B and C. Floor area (850 sqm), capacity (60 people), location near public transport and the CDP/PNRR funding context are not energy-efficiency requirements and are not included.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters office-type properties (Uffici e assimilabili) with surface_area >= 850, energy_class in A1–A4/B/C, mobility >= 71, and within 3.0 km of the supplied coordinates. Results are ordered by haversine distance to that point, ascending.
